aboutOne.title: “In his name the nations will put their hope.”
aboutOne.description1: Hope 4 All is a registered ministry with the Council of Christian Education – Synod of the Nile, focused on equipping and empowering church ministers and leaders within local churches across Egypt, the Middle East and North Africa.
aboutOne.description2: The ministry began in 2008 by Dr. Rev. Radi Iskander by translating a single training manual for Sunday School teachers. Over time, it expanded to include a variety of programs targeting all age groups.

header.title: Vision &
header.description: Empowering church leaders across the Middle East and North Africa to transform communities through intentional discipleship

vision.label: Our Vision

quote.text: “And the things you have heard me say in the presence of many witnesses entrust to reliable people who will also be qualified to teach others.”

vision.title: Multiplying Disciples Across Nations
vision.description: To see empowered local church leaders in Egypt, the Middle East, and North Africa who multiply discipleship, build healthy churches, and reach unreached and under-resourced areas, carrying the message of Christ’s hope to all.

mission.label: Our Mission
mission.title: Equipping Leaders for Kingdom Impact
mission.description1: We are committed to equipping and empowering local church leaders by providing comprehensive and accessible training resources for all.
mission.description2: We focus on developing a network of qualified trainers who will:

points.societies: Engage their societies with the hope of Christ

mission.unity: Maintaining the unity of the Church as the Body of Christ
mission.statement: To equip and empower local church leaders with accessible and inclusive training resources, fostering a network of qualified trainers who nurture discipleship, support vulnerable groups, and engage communities with the message of Christ’s hope, all while upholding the unity of the Church as the body of Christ.

strategies.label: Strategies
items: Empower leaders through trainings and resources to carry the message of Christ’s hope to all.
Help local churches to serve the community through developmental, social and spiritual projects.
Helping refugees inside and outside Egypt.
Providing biblical education for everyone and encouraging a new generation of enlightened writers to write through a publishing house.
Helping youth through various vocational training programs.

worldMapImpact.title: Serving communities across the MENA region.
worldMapImpact.description: Through our dedicated volunteers and ministry partners, Hope For All MENA reaches communities across the Middle East, North Africa, and beyond with hope, education, and transformational resources.
